name: ai.gtinfetch/gtinfetch
title: gtinfetch – Agentic Commerce
description: gtinfetch — the GTIN resolver for AI agents. Any barcode, one call. 84M GTINs. x402 at the door.

tools.name: fetch_gtin
tools.description: What is this GTIN? Returns the signed record for a GTIN-8/12/13/14: product, brand, maker, category and pack where a source page states them, each with the pages it was read from and the date it was read; seen_in markets and banners; confidence confirmed (two or more independent domains agree) or seen (one). A GTIN with no observation answers status unknown with no fields — never a guess. Pass market (hub market code; UK accepted for GB) to tag the ask with the market: a miss is queued as a lead for that market. Can it be sold there is the hub's gate, not this door's. Extended 2026-11-13: every answer also carries answer (verified · not verified · unknown, by the published rule at https://gtinfetch.ai/rule.json), reason, facts with the variant facts (size, pack count, type), facts_compared, sources_read (each source with its last-read date), rule_version and region. Optional inputs: market (used for the recall check), believes {brand, product, size} (what you believe you are buying), receipt (true writes a signed receipt of the check in the same call at https://rco.wefetch.ai/; anyone can check it at https://rco-barcodeverified.org/verify). A barcode-only call returns everything it returned before, with the new fields beside the old.

market.description: optional hub market code, e.g. UK, US, FR

believes.description: optional: what the agent believes it is buying, as the agent holds it. Checked against the record; facts_compared says what was checked and what could not be.

receipt.description: optional: true writes a signed receipt of this check in the same call, at https://rco.wefetch.ai/. The answer is always given; the receipt is what is paid for.
